reserveReview.rationale: BDO reconciles the aggregate June 30 fiat-token reserve pool of USD 187,751,426,411 against USD 183,641,897,215 total liabilities, including USD 183,622,105,630 token liabilities. Legal terms place MXNT in that shared reserve model. This single basket records the whole shared claim but does not import USDT percentages or infer a dedicated peso-denominated allocation.
